items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Lucien and Charlie Barbarin, we have two sons... Lucien and Charlie Barbarin, we were teaching them traditional music

ctx.x: See, if you walk under... [AWAY FROM MICROPHONE, NOT AUDIBLE] ...all over my pants(?), we have a she-brick. Or heave(?) a stone, see. See, my grandfather was a master at watching stones, Old Man Barbarin. See, he could dig back around the stone(?)... [BOTH LAUGH]
What did he play, your grandfather, Danny?
